_doc: Type-A (overlay) RTLink thunk -> overlay function map for VICEROY.EXE. Each Type-A thunk carries a page_id trailer (overlay segment) and a JMPF offset plus a secondary disambiguation word (ljmp_seg). CORRECT resolution formula: target_file_offset = page.code_offset + (ljmp_seg<<4) + jmpf_off. Produced by tools/rtlink/rtlink_decode.py (resolver authority; validate ALL PASS). 157 thunk targets corrected from prior version which omitted the (ljmp_seg<<4) term.

hit_rate.note: 100%% of resolved targets land inside real page code. The exact-entry fraction improved from 66.0%% to 83.7%% after fixing the ljmp_seg term. 157 targets changed; 501 are unchanged (ljmp_seg==0 so both formulas agree).
